name: Heaven and Hell
description: A utility for toggling between a light and a dark Emacs theme with a single keypress, shown with the built-in Wombat theme.
elispBefore: (setq heaven-and-hell-theme-type 'dark) (setq heaven-and-hell-themes '((light . tsdh-light) (dark . wombat))) (setq heaven-and-hell-load-theme-no-confirm t)
